name: Actron Technology Corporation
summary: Actron Technology Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of electronic components in China, Korea, Taiwan, Mexico, France, the Czech Republic, Hungary, India, and internationally. It offers power modules, automotive pressfit diodes, power discrete, and power device wafer/bare die products. The company is also involved in the manufacture of power generation, transmission, and distribution machinery; semiconductor business; wholesale and retail sale of electronic materials; provision of leasing and manpower dispatch services; and research, development, manufacture, and sale of LCD driving ICs and other application-specific ICs.
